summary: Calm 3D water-flow puzzle on the travertine terraces of Pamukkale, built by Claude Haiku 5.5 · Pamukkale travertenlerinde sakin 3D su akışı bulmacası, Claude Haiku 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Guide spring water into target pools with a limited set of stones, dams and splitters
Still water builds calcium, so the terraces rise and change while the water runs
20 levels in 4 areas with three stars each: all pools full, no water spilled, tool saving
Every level checked offline against the same simulation code (tools/solve-levels.mjs)
The ?auto bot cleared 20/20 levels with 46/60 stars; one index.html, everything generated in code

social.headline: Guide warm spring water into the white travertine pools · Ilık kaynak suyunu beyaz traverten havuzlarına yönlendir
